admission_gate.a38_live_activation: separate authenticated live-frame receipt required; this handoff does not activate or schedule d84
admission_gate.wave5_central_rust_validation: bound PASS Final/All attestation required before refreeze

consumer_laws.a38_authority: A38 runtime rows are usable only when the same snapshot carries the exact d84 authority object and its contiguous manager_order is a one-to-one cover of every country/gui row.
consumer_laws.a38_portability: Producer identities, diagnostics, winning-layer identities, and GUI ids are bounded and pointer/path-free; raw pointers and host paths never enter portable replay.
consumer_laws.a38_tombstones: Tombstones are strictly sorted, unique, disjoint from current rows, and never converted into current false/empty values.
consumer_laws.a38_unavailable: A null or absent d84 authority is unavailable, never measured empty; runtime rows without exact authority are rejected as a unit.
consumer_laws.absent: An absent optional field means it was not sourced or not projected; consumers must not synthesize a value.
consumer_laws.closed_absence: Do not synthesize persistent wing pairings or reinforcement-source enums rejected by A4/A21, or tokens for unknown/mod-added building ids.
consumer_laws.empty: An empty array is a measured empty set only when its owning sidecar is present and non-null.
consumer_laws.fixed_point: Use raw integer fields for deterministic replay and the supplied scale/divisor for display.
consumer_laws.identity: Numeric *_tag_db_id fields are the stable identity; resolved TAG strings are presentation joins.
consumer_laws.unknown: A null promoted sidecar means the domain/hour is unknown and must never be rendered as an empty measurement.

required_external_gates: one authenticated live d84 producer frame bound to the exact a729 executable, effective-VFS identity, exact20 A38 static receipt, and producer manifest
the live frame must prove complete effective GUI-key coverage in CScriptedWindowManager updater order, including measured-empty and tombstone transitions
domain 84 must remain reserved and unscheduled until that receipt is accepted and the repository central Rust gate is green
rules: the carrier is generic and mod-extensible; no per-panel ids, trigger names, properties, or effects are frozen
unsupported engine results are explicit value=null plus a portable unavailable_reason and are never coerced to false or empty
manager_order_index is contiguous from zero and the authority manager_order exactly covers the folded country/gui rows
definition identity is the authenticated effective-VFS winner with canonical game-relative path and nonzero source/payload hashes
tombstones are strictly sorted, unique, and disjoint from current rows
paused is boolean or null and is present only when the exact paused flag is carried
numeric decision targets retain target_kind=numeric and require the frozen static decision definition to interpret state scope
country targets retain target_tag_db_id plus the resolved target
null _r2_depth_targets means omitted/incomplete target rows, never an empty target set
damage rows preserve channel, cause_type, exact cause label, amount_raw, and scale_raw
record identity preserves owner, region, side, flags, wing, date, plane count, mission mask, and attributed country
full-snapshot rows preserve month, convoys, killer_country, and owner
construction rows preserve target_location_id, target_scope, repair_levels_remaining, and is_repair
building rows preserve level, healthy_level, damaged, and optional partial_health_raw
type_0xNNNNNNNN is always retained; token is added only for an exact shared-registry match
all 24 raw channels and all 24 display divisors are required per admitted row
raw is authoritative; channels is the derived display value
row identity is owner/province/actor
motorization_level is exactly 1 or 2 and truck_fraction_raw is exactly 50000 or 100000
retain the exact compact event row without inventing persona/session fields
chat and system_message require the validated message source family
hotjoin and tag_switch require the validated player-event source family
event families fail closed independently and must not poison valid players_by_country or pause
